mapper.sql: est03_pf_history_id AS pf_history_id, est03_pf_contract_id AS pf_contract_id, est03_no AS no, est03_start_date AS start_date, est03_close_date AS close_date, est03_content AS content, est03_detail AS detail, est03_person_id AS person_id, f_emp_kor_nm(est03_person_id) AS person_name, f_get_emptrans(est03_person_id, est03_close_date, 'org_code_nm') AS org_name, est03_status_cd AS status_code, f_cdnm('StatusCode', est03_status_cd, est03_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS status_name, est03_confirmer_id AS confirmer_id, f_emp_kor_nm(est03_confirmer_id) AS confirmer_name, ( SELECT COUNT(*)||'건' FROM est04_pf_file WHERE est04_pf_history_id = est03_pf_history_id ) AS file_count_str
mapper.select: SELECT f_get_confirmer_parent(#{personId}, #{date}) AS confirmer_id, f_emp_kor_nm(f_get_confirmer_parent(#{personId}, #{date})) AS confirmer_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO est03_pf_history (est03_pf_history_id, est03_company_id, est03_pf_contract_id, est03_no, est03_start_date, est03_close_date, est03_content, est03_detail, est03_person_id, est03_status_cd, est03_confirmer_id) VALUES (#{r.pfHistoryId}, #{companyId}, #{r.pfContractId}, #{r.no}, #{r.startDate}, #{r.closeDate}, #{r.content}, #{r.detail}, #{r.personId}, #{r.statusCode}, #{r.confirmerId})
mapper.update: UPDATE est03_pf_history SET est03_no = #{r.no}, est03_start_date = #{r.startDate}, est03_close_date = #{r.closeDate}, est03_content = #{r.content}, est03_detail = #{r.detail}, est03_person_id = #{r.personId}, est03_status_cd = #{r.statusCode}, est03_confirmer_id = #{r.confirmerId} WHERE est03_pf_history_id = #{r.pfHistoryId} AND est03_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.select: SELECT est04_pf_file_id AS pf_file_id, est04_pf_history_id AS pf_history_id, est04_file_desc AS file_desc, est04_check_route AS check_route, sys10_file_id AS file_id, sys10_file_nm AS file_name FROM est04_pf_file INNER JOIN est03_pf_history ON est03_pf_history_id = est04_pf_history_id LEFT OUTER JOIN sys10_file ON sys10_parent_id = est04_pf_file_id WHERE est04_pf_history_id = #{pfHistoryId} AND est03_company_id = #{companyId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM est04_pf_file WHERE est04_pf_file_id = #{pfFileId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO est04_pf_file (est04_pf_file_id, est04_pf_history_id, est04_file_desc, est04_check_route) VALUES (#{r.pfFileId}, #{pfHistoryId}, #{r.fileDesc}, #{r.checkRoute})
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM est03_pf_history INNER JOIN est02_pf_contract ON est02_pf_contract_id = est03_pf_contract_id LEFT OUTER JOIN est01_pf_fee_type ON est01_pf_fee_type_id = est02_pf_fee_type_id WHERE est03_company_id = #{companyId} AND est03_confirmer_id = #{personId} AND #{startDate} BETWEEN est03_start_date AND COALESCE(est03_close_date, TO_DATE('29991231', 'yyyyMMdd')) AND UPPER(CONCAT(est02_borrower, est02_project_site_nm, f_cdnm('EstPfFeeCode', est01_fee_cd, est02_company_id, f_sysdate()))) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) AND COALESCE(est03_status_cd,'00') IN ('10','20')
AND COALESCE(est03_status_cd,'00') NOT IN ('20')
ORDER BY est03_start_date, est03_pf_history_id
